text: 10月21日，数字人民币运营管理中心对外公布数字人民币基础设施服务体系，推出央行端数字人民币系统（DCEPS）、数字人民币智能合约生态服务框架（e-CNY SMART Contract）两大核心成果。（新华社）
text_en: On October 21, the Digital RMB Operations Management Center announced the digital renminbi infrastructure service system, launching two core achievements: the central bank digital renminbi system (DCEPS) and the digital renminbi smart contract ecosystem service framework (e-CNY SMART Contract). (Xinhua News Agency)
